messages:
rachel: quick question  should runtime flag rollouts consider quota headroom before increasing cohorts?
omar: yes. saw a case where ramping to 20% hit tenant quota and produced 429s, downstream cascade.
tyler: suggestion: when a config triggers a higher expected token usage, consult QuotaService for projected peak and gate ramp if headroom < X%.
sophia: agree. X should be something like 30% by default. keep conservative.
rachel: UX: show projected "quota impact" line in the rollout preview with a red/yellow/green indicator. link to per-tenant quota details.
omar: implementation detail: add an async preflight endpoint /internal/rollout_preflight that returns small decisions: [allowed:boolean, reasons:list, projected_tokens:string].
tyler: prefer snake_case and tiny payloads. also return recommended_max_cohort as string so console can default the slider.
infra-bot: preflight-check: rollout r-2026-04-01-11 preflight_start at 1757772250
sophia: telemetry concern: how do we validate projections? add a historical-simulate mode: replay recent traffic against proposed config to estimate delta.
rachel: yes, simulate using last 24h traffic sample and return 95th percentile projected increase. treat it as advisory.
omar: edge-case: if tenant uses burst quota, projection must consider burst window. QuotaService should expose burst_remaining and burst_window.
tyler: also important: routing policies may split traffic across model variants with different token multipliers. preflight must aggregate across routing table.
sophia: for multi-tenant dedicated hosts, preflight should warn when colocated customers might tip host-level GPU memory or batch limits.
rachel: console behavior: when preflight returns recommended_max_cohort < requested, show a blocking confirmation and an option to override with two-person approval.
omar: audit: every override must be recorded with operator, reason, and TTL. store in config_audit.
tyler: monitoring: when rollout starts, emit a compact event to /internal/rollout_watch with fields rollout_id, cohort_pct, preflight_hash, and expected_token_delta. keep it tiny and link to snapshot.
infra-bot: watch-event: r-2026-04-01-11 cohort=5% preflight_hash=abc123 at 1757772300
sophia: alerts: if actual token consumption > projected +10% within first 10 minutes, create a soft pause event and notify owners.
rachel: tie this into routing: if a variant causes spike, fallback routing should automatically reduce weight to other variants by N% until operator inspects.
omar: need cooldown and backoff: do not oscillate weights too fast. implement exponential backoff on automated adjustments.
tyler: operator tooling: rwdctl preflight <rollout_id> to fetch preflight summary and rwdctl simulate --range to run local replay. ops loves CLI.
sophia: also expose a lightweight trace link per tenant to inspect per-tenant token usage spikes. must respect privacy settings.
rachel: privacy gate: for tenants with pii_sensitive=true, preflight simulation must mask request contents and limit trace sampling.
omar: QA: build a small harness that generates synthetic token-hungry requests to validate preflight accuracy in staging.
tyler: rollout step: when creating a rollout, console stores preflight_hash and shows a changelog entry with results. if preflight is stale (older than 6h), warn before applying.
infra-bot: deploy-note: preflight-service v0.1 deployed to staging at 1757773000
rachel: decision: ship preflight advisory + conservative gating defaults (require headroom >=30% to auto-ramp beyond 10%). no forced hard blocks except on explicit tenant blocking flags.
sophia: action items: rachel=API spec for /internal/rollout_preflight, omar=QuotaService hook, tyler=CLI stubs + simulation harness, sophia=console UI mock + privacy behavior.
tyler: I'll put a tiny openapi snippet in the repo and start a branch.
omar: I'll add burst fields to the QuotaService read model.
infra-bot: saved-thread: rollout-preflight-quota-checks at 1757773600
